<thought>We have the mass spectrum indicating a molecular weight of ~194 Da, consistent with the formula C₁₄H₁₀O. To narrow down which of the many possible C₁₄H₁₀O isomers matches the sample, we need additional spectroscopic data. The next most informative inexpensive experiment is the 13C NMR, which will reveal the number and type of carbon environments (e.g., carbonyl, aromatic, etc.). This will let us eliminate many candidates before proceeding to ¹H NMR if needed.</thought>
